title: Media Studio
partialBanner: This job finished with partial failures (some segments). Export may still work for successful segments.

error.NO_AUDIO_STREAM: This video has no audio track. Translation and summarization require audio.

selectProjectHint: Choose the workspace project before uploading or reviewing media jobs.
modeTranslateOnlyDesc: Keep the full video duration. Automatically translate subtitles and dub audio into the target language.
modeHybridDesc: Keeps the source wording and audio; AI only proposes highlight ranges to cut.
modeGenerativeDesc: AI rewrites the key ideas into a shorter translated narration, like a review-style recap.
subtitleSoftHelp: Exports .srt/.vtt alongside the video. Viewers can turn captions on or off.
subtitleHardHelp: Text is burned into the video frames (cannot be turned off). .srt/.vtt files are still available to download.
sourceLangHelp: Language is detected from the audio.
noProjectDesc: Choose a project to upload media and create jobs.
emptyDesc: Upload a video and create a media job to get started.
jobCreatedHint: Stages will start processing in the background.

panels.overviewSub: List jobs in this project. Click a row to open pipeline tracking.
panels.uploadSub: Upload video, accept terms, choose a recipe.
panels.jobOverviewSub: Identifiers, recipe, languages, progress & source override.
panels.proposalsSub: Pick one of 3 AI cuts or define your own range.
panels.narrativePlanSub: Review sections, beats, script, source refs, and timing.
panels.trimSub: Cut intro/outro before translate — skip to keep the full video.
panels.reviewSub: Cross-check QA severity against subtitle text & timing.
panels.voiceSub: Default keeps original audio. TTS is optional — not required to continue.
panels.subtitleStyleSub: Pick a system preset for burned-in and exported subtitles.
panels.finishRenderSub: Voice, subtitle layer, presentation, and TTS → mix → render progress.

stageDesc.SKIPPED: Not applicable for this recipe / choice (e.g. original audio)

pipeline.title: Stage Pipeline Tracking
pipeline.rerunFromStageDesc: Select a stage to rerun from the beginning (up to the current active stage):
pipeline.rerunConfirmDesc: The system will rerun from stage {{stage}} and reset subsequent stages. Are you sure?
pipeline.ttsSkippedWithVoiceSelected: A voice was selected but dubbing was skipped — please review this job
pipeline.overrideConfirm: This re-runs TRANSLATE → TTS → RENDER with the new source language. STT is not re-run. Continue?
pipeline.staleWarn: Changing the source language re-runs TRANSLATE → TTS → RENDER with the new language. STT is not re-run — the transcript is language-independent.

recovery.emptyCues: Subtitle timeline has no usable cues — restore or edit the translated text and timing, then Save and re-run Voice Dub & Render.
recovery.durationMismatch: Subtitle timing does not cover the video sufficiently — check the timing of your subtitle lines, especially around the ending, then Save and re-run Voice Dub & Render.
recovery.generativeTtsDurationMismatch: Generative narration is outside the requested duration — subtitle start/end edits cannot fix this TTS mismatch.

upload.dropTitle: Drop video here or click to browse
upload.progressHint: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes.
upload.processingHint: File sent — saving and reading video info.
upload.noPermission: You do not have permission to upload media.

consent.title: Content rights consent
consent.body: By confirming, you declare that you own this content, have a license, or have explicit permission to use it for translation and dubbing in this workspace. Derived assets inherit this consent.
consent.checkbox: I confirm I have the rights to use this video for translation and dubbing in this workspace, and accept responsibility per the current Terms.

create.durationHelp: Pick a preset or enter mm:ss (tolerance ±10s or ±10%).
create.durationHelpGenerative: Pick a preset or enter mm:ss (summary targets this length, tolerance ±10%).
create.invalidDuration: Enter a valid duration (mm:ss or seconds).
create.generativeUnavailable: Narrative summary is not enabled on this server. The option has been hidden.

proposals.hint: Pick one AI proposal or define your own cut. After you select, the job continues to Translate and the choice is locked.
proposals.narrativeHint: Single AI summary plan. The pipeline continues automatically after Summarize — no selection needed.
proposals.lockedHint: A proposal is selected and locked. The pipeline continues with this cut plan.
proposals.narrativeLockedHint: Single committed plan. The pipeline continues automatically.
proposals.emptyDesc: Wait for Summarize to finish, or create your own cut.
proposals.narrativeEmptyDesc: Wait for Summarize to finish and generate a narrative plan.
proposals.cutTimelineHint: Kept ranges on the source timeline
proposals.customEntryHint: Click to define your own cut range.
proposals.customFormOpen: Enter a time range below, then create the proposal.
proposals.invalidRange: End must be greater than start (seconds).
proposals.rerunBlocked: Cannot rerun after the selected plan has been activated with translations

refine.label: Refinement request
refine.placeholder: Tell the AI how to improve the narrative plan (at least 10 characters). E.g. Focus more on the action scenes, shorten the intro, add more details to the ending...
refine.modalDesc: Review current section coverage and specify new requirements for AI to regenerate the summary script.
refine.reviewOnlyNotice: AI-generated narrative summary. You can review the plan below or refine the proposal anytime.

narrative.tooltipNoDialogue: No original dialogue recorded in this range
narrative.engineCutsHint: Rendering references used internally by the rendering pipeline. Not editable. The narrative body (sections + script) is the source of truth.

trim.hint: Optional trim. Skip to translate the full video.
trim.optionalNote: Trim is optional. Leaving this empty keeps the full localization timeline.
trim.skipHint: Skip this panel to translate the full timeline.

waitingForProposal.title: Pipeline is paused — pick a cut proposal to continue translation.
waitingForProposal.narrativeTitle: Pipeline is paused — select a narrative plan to continue translation.

cancel.title: Cancel media job?
cancel.body: Cancellation is graceful — the current stage finishes its in-flight work before the job stops.
cancel.gracefulHint: Current stage: {{stage}}. You may wait a few seconds after confirming.
cancel.waiting: Cancel requested — waiting for {{stage}} to finish before full stop.

export.blockedDesc: Unresolved issues with BLOCK_EXPORT must be resolved or overridden (Admin/PM) before download.
export.waitRender: Video export unlocks after RENDER completes.
export.needArtifactDesc: RENDER finished but no rendered video file is available yet — re-run the render stage.
export.needTranslateDesc: Subtitles unlock once the TRANSLATE stage has created segments.
export.alwaysBoth: SRT and VTT are always available independently of hard/soft subtitle mode.
export.videoDesc: The finished video after the RENDER stage — dubbed audio and subtitles follow the confirmed render configuration.
export.srtDesc: Standard SubRip subtitle file, always exported independently of hard/soft subtitle mode.
export.vttDesc: WebVTT subtitle file for web players.
export.videoListSubtitle: Preview finished video, inspect technical specifications, and download video with companion subtitles.

qa.waitDesc: QA issues appear after the TRANSLATE stage creates segments.
qa.overlapHint: {{count}} subtitle_overlap issue(s) — may permanently block render.

subtitles.waitDesc: Subtitle lines appear after the Translate step finishes.
subtitles.emptyDesc: No translation segments found for this media job.
subtitles.hint: Edit the translated text and timing on the original video timeline. After saving, re-run Voice Dub & Render.
subtitles.invalidRange: End must be greater than start.

recovery.emptyCuesBody: The render could not start because the subtitle timeline has no usable cues. Enter or restore the translated content, or check that segment timing falls inside the selected cut ranges.
recovery.durationMismatchTitle: Subtitle timing does not cover the video
recovery.durationMismatchBody: The subtitle timeline does not cover the expected video duration. Check the timing of your subtitle lines — especially around the ending — then save and re-run.
recovery.generativeTtsTitle: Generative narration is shorter than target
recovery.generativeTtsBody: The dubbed narration is {{actual}} / target {{target}}, short by about {{missing}}. Timing is built from TTS, so editing start/end cannot fix this mismatch.
recovery.generativeTtsAction: Use the measured narration repair and re-run Voice Dub & Render; do not adjust subtitle start/end for this mismatch.
recovery.action: After saving your changes, use Re-run Voice Dub & Render to reprocess.

subtitles.readyToProceedHint: Done reviewing subtitles? Proceed to Voice & Render.
subtitles.tooManyToSave: Too many edits ({{limit}} max per batch) — save in smaller groups.
subtitles.invalidRangeSeq: Cue #{{seq}}: end must be after start.
subtitles.noMatch: No cues match the current filter.
subtitles.seekNote: Click a cue to seek the video

voice.hint: Default keeps the original audio. You do not need to pick a TTS voice for the job to continue — TTS is skipped automatically when no voice is set.
voice.regenHint: Changing the voice later re-queues Voice Dub and/or Render after Translate has completed (audio is regenerated with the new choice).
voice.originalHint: Skip TTS and use the source audio for the entire job.
voice.empty: No active TTS voices for this language. You can still continue with original audio.

preview.rateLimited: Please try again in a minute.

voice.preJobHint: Optional for full localization and extractive highlights. Keeping the original voice skips TTS but still translates the subtitles.
voice.generativeDeferredHint: Voice is not chosen at create for generative summary. After translation finishes, pick a target-language voice in Prepare render — original audio is never kept for this recipe.
voice.presetVoiceHint: This preset defines its own TTS voice, so the selector is hidden — the preset voice is applied when the job is created. Change it later in Job Studio if needed.
voice.label: TTS voice
voice.providerHelp: Voices are listed for the selected provider only.
voice.voiceHelp: Only active voices compatible with the target language are shown.
voice.emptyCompat: No active TTS voices match the target language for this provider. Select another provider or keep the original voice.
voice.boundProviderMissing: The provider bound to this job is no longer available in this workspace. Contact an administrator to re-configure TTS.
voice.noProviderSelectable: No enabled TTS provider is available in this workspace.

renderPrep.title: Prepare render
renderPrep.subtitle: Review the summary script, voice and subtitle placement before rendering.
renderPrep.waiting: Translation and QA are still running. This checkpoint unlocks when they finish.
renderPrep.mandatoryDesc: Generative summaries always replace source audio with translated narration. Choose a target-language voice and confirm — original speech is not mixed in.
renderPrep.noProvider: No default TTS provider is configured.
renderPrep.noVoice: No active voice matches the target language.
renderPrep.softSubWarning: Position is guaranteed only for hard subtitles. Video players may ignore placement for soft subtitles.
renderPrep.dragCoverLayer: Drag to move this cover layer
renderPrep.previewDragHint: Drag the subtitle vertically. Drag a cover layer freely in any direction; its horizontal and vertical values update automatically.
renderPrep.readOnlyHint: This job has no manual render checkpoint - the configuration is shown for reference.
renderPrep.lockedHint: Render settings are locked. TTS and rendering are already in progress.
renderPrep.subtitleLayerHint: Controls translated subtitle content and typography. Cover overlays are configured separately.
renderPrep.displayModeSentence: Full sentence (1 cue per segment — entire paragraph)
renderPrep.displayModeWord: Word-by-word (one cue per word — Reels/TikTok style)
renderPrep.summaryGroupingHint: Note: Summary videos have long spoken segments (30–60s). Selecting 'Full sentence' will show a large text block. Choose 'Phrase' or 'Word-by-word' for dynamic, readable subtitles.
renderPrep.reapplyHint: Re-generate subtitle files with new settings and re-render video. Existing TTS voice and audio mix will be preserved.
renderPrep.maxCharactersPerCueHint: Long cues are split into lines of at most this many characters.
renderPrep.maxCharactersInvalid: Characters per cue must be a whole number between 10 and 80.
renderPrep.maskOpacityHint: Lower the color opacity (10–25%) with Blur for a transparent frosted-glass overlay — the blurred video stays visible through the mask.
renderPrep.ownershipTooltip: An assigned subtitle style owns text/background colors, the box toggle and subtitle placement. Clear the style to edit these controls.
renderPrep.outlineBoxWarning: Turn off the text background box to customize the letter stroke outline.
renderPrep.maskLayerHint: Add cover regions independently from the subtitle style. Use them to hide existing burned-in text or other fixed areas.
renderPrep.layerCapNote: Up to 4 layers are supported by the contract; v1 edits a single overlay anchored to the subtitle line.
renderPrep.maskPaddingReserved: paddingPercent is reserved — no visual effect in v1.
renderPrep.softSubPresentationWarning: Typography only applies to hard subtitles — players control soft-subtitle rendering.
renderPrep.softSubCoverWarning: Cover overlays require hard subtitles in the current render contract. Switch the subtitle layer to Hard subtitles to edit them.
renderPrep.ducking: Lower background audio during speech (Audio Ducking)
renderPrep.duckingHint: When narration starts, background music or original audio is automatically reduced so the voice stays clear.
renderPrep.audioMixNote: Applied when the AUDIO_MIX stage runs.
renderPrep.audioMixSkippedNote: Audio presentation is not available for this job (AUDIO_MIX is skipped).
renderPrep.bgColorStyleNote: If a subtitle style preset is assigned, the background color comes from the preset — these controls are locked.
renderPrep.textColorNote: Applies to burned-in (HARD_SUB) subtitles only. When a style preset is assigned, the text color is owned by the preset.
renderPrep.coverHint: Each layer covers an independent region — top / middle / bottom edge of the frame, or following the subtitle line — while the subtitle itself can sit elsewhere. Up to 4 layers; Solid fills a colour, Blur frosts the region.
renderPrep.coverEmptyTitle: No cover overlay in the render
renderPrep.coverEmptyHint: Add one only when the source already contains text that must be hidden.
renderPrep.aspectHint: The worker reframes the output before burning subtitles — blurred cover background with the full video fitted centered (no content cropped). Subtitle/mask geometry follows the new frame.

workflow.manualHelp: Pause at each checkpoint — confirm before the pipeline continues.
workflow.autoHelp: Run through checkpoints automatically after create. Safety gates (QA, duration, empty-cue, capability) stay active.

workflowPreset.label: Workflow preset
workflowPreset.invalid: The selected preset is no longer available. Choose another preset or no preset.
workflowPreset.subtitle: Subtitles: {{mode}}
workflowPreset.modeOverrideNote: The selected mode ({{mode}}) wins over this preset's workflow mode.
workflowPreset.hint: The preset is resolved and frozen when the job is created. Fields selected above take precedence over the preset.
workflowPreset.voiceLangMismatch: The preset voice does not support the job's target language.

workflowPresetAdmin.title: Workflow presets
workflowPresetAdmin.subtitle: Presets are template/default configurations, not locks: a job created from a preset freezes the configuration at create time; editing the preset later never affects existing jobs.
workflowPresetAdmin.deleteDesc: Jobs already created from this preset keep their frozen configuration.
workflowPresetAdmin.formHint: Presets are templates — jobs created afterwards resolve this configuration and freeze it at create time.
workflowPresetAdmin.name: Name
workflowPresetAdmin.defaultConflict: A default preset already exists in this scope. Clear the current default first.
workflowPresetAdmin.projectFilterHint: Pick a project to see project-scoped presets.
workflowPresetAdmin.voiceConfiguredTooltip: This preset binds a fixed voice. Jobs created from it will use this voice (if target language matches).
workflowPresetAdmin.voiceDefaultTooltip: No fixed voice assigned. Voice will be automatically selected based on target language at job creation.
workflowPresetAdmin.halfPair: Choose a full provider + voice pair, or neither.
workflowPresetAdmin.voiceHint: Optional. When a voice is set, jobs created from this preset must have a matching target language (otherwise creation is rejected with 422).
workflowPresetAdmin.previewNote: The frame ratio only affects this preview. The rendered video always keeps its original ratio.
workflowPresetAdmin.bgColorStyleNote: Jobs with an assigned Subtitle Style take the text background from that style (B1.1 owns it). This color applies to the standard subtitle path.
workflowPresetAdmin.textColorNote: The color of the subtitle text. This applies to the standard subtitle path (not the assigned Subtitle Style).
workflowPresetAdmin.maskFollowsSubtitle: The mask always follows the subtitle line (position + vertical offset) so it covers the old burned-in subtitle exactly.
workflowPresetAdmin.previewAspectReal: This frame is the REAL output aspect — the rendered video is reframed (blur-pad).
workflowPresetAdmin.calibrationNote: Calibration media stays in this browser tab only (never uploaded) — use it to align masks and subtitles against real content.

executionMode.label: Audio execution mode
executionMode.loadError: Could not read deployment availability. Job creation is blocked until it can be verified.
executionMode.noneSupported: This deployment reports no supported audio execution mode.
executionMode.blockedUnavailable: {{mode}} is not available on this deployment.
executionMode.blockedNotHonoured: {{mode}} cannot be requested on this deployment yet. Job creation is blocked rather than silently run in another mode.

reason.PRODUCT_UNSUPPORTED: Not supported by this product recipe.
reason.READINESS_UNKNOWN: Runtime readiness has not been evaluated yet.
reason.WORKER_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH: No compatible worker for this mode.
reason.NOT_EVALUATED: Runtime readiness has not been evaluated yet.

subtitleStyle.unknownPreset: This job uses a stored style that no longer matches an available preset.
subtitleStyle.emptyDesc: No active system presets are configured for this deployment.

error.INVALID_STYLE_KEY: That subtitle style key is not valid.
error.STYLE_NOT_FOUND: That subtitle style no longer exists.
error.STYLE_NOT_ACTIVE: That subtitle style is no longer active. Pick another one.

subtitleStyle.compactHint: Optional preset: when assigned it owns font, colors and background for burned-in subtitles and locks the manual color controls below. Leave empty to style manually.

vlm.toggleDesc: Extract video frames and perform multimodal visual analysis to enhance summary accuracy (falls back cleanly to text-only if disabled or provider unavailable).

batch.noFiles: No videos added yet. Add one or more video files to start a batch.
batch.keepOriginalHint: Applies to every job in this batch — no dubbing voice is configured.
batch.consentBatchHint: This confirmation applies to every video in this batch.
batch.missingVoice: Please select both Provider and Voice before creating the batch.
batch.noTtsProviders: No TTS providers available in this workspace.
batch.noNxN: Batch v1 creates either N videos × 1 language or 1 video × N languages — never both at once.
batch.multiVideoLocksTarget: With several videos staged, every job shares this one target language.

review.videoPending: Video preview will be available once translation completes.
review.seekHint: Play the video to check cues against the picture
